name: drift-detect-cpu

config.name: drift-detect-cpu
config.description: Threshold vs CUSUM drift detection delay and false alarms on 7 drift scenarios x 3 reps

notes: Detection delay is window end minus onset in capture time (the live monitor adds settle_s and the scrape interval). Operating points are chosen on the other repetitions (leave one repetition out); the sweep is in sample. Clips loop every 17 to 35 s, so clean windows are more alike than on a real camera and false-alarm rates are optimistic.
